status_effects.explanation: The duchess's direct, warm attention and stated wish to have shown him more of her collection marks the narrator as an included, favored guest in this staged interaction.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Je suis contente que vous ayez vu mes Elstir, mais j'avoue que je l'aurais été encore bien plus, si j'avais pu vous faire les honneurs de mon Hals, de ce tableau « fieffé ». »
appraisal_events.explanation: The duchess personally and warmly addresses the narrator, expressing pleasure that he saw her Elstirs and regret she could not also show him her prized Hals, treating him as a guest worth favoring.
